description: Variation of Condition 2 (Approved Drawings) to allow the erection of a single storey side extension to Planning Permission P/2021/4479 approved 12 August 2022 for the 'Change of use from offices to five dwellings, erection of a roof extension with front roof windows, with associated amenity space, landscaping and cycle and refuse storage'.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of 12 August 2022.  

Reason:  In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved drawings and statements:  DWD.01, 800 - PROPOSED GROUND FLOOR PLAN, 801 - PROPOSED ROOF PLAN, 802 - PROPOSED ELEVATIONS, 803 - BLOCK PLAN Received:  06 February 2025,  21-8866, 701 - PROPOSED FIRST FLOOR PLAN, 703 - PROPOSED ELEVATIONS AND SECTION XX Received:  30 May 2022,  01 - EXISTING GROUND FLOOR PLAN, 02 - EXISTING FIRST FLOOR PLAN, 03 - EXISTING ROOF PLAN, 04 - EXISTING ELEVATIONS, 05 - EXISTING ELEVATIONS AND SECTION AA, 14121, 702-PROPOSED ROOF PLAN, 703-PROPOSED ELEVATIONS AND SECTION XX Received:  23 November 2021.  

The development hereby approved shall be implemented in accordance with the Proposed Section XX and proposed window details only included within 703 - PROPOSED ELEVATIONS AND SECTION XX, which is otherwise superseded by submitted drawing 802 - PROPOSED ELEVATIONS.  

Reason:  In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the mansard roof extension and single storey side extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.  

Reason:  To protect the character and appearance of the building and Strand on the Green Conservation Area, in accordance with Local Plan Policies SC7, CC1, CC2 and CC4.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.00am to 6.00pm on Monday to Friday and 9.00am to 1.00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.  

Reasons:  To prevent noise nuisance to neighbouring properties in accordance with Local Plan Policy EQ5.

Condition : 5 - The windows installed in the building's first floor southern front elevation hereby permitted shall be obscure glazed, non-opening and permanently retained as such.  

Reason:  To protect neighbours' living conditions in accordance with Local Plan Policies SC7 and CC2.

Condition : 6 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the mansard roof extension and single storey side extension hereby permitted.  

Reason:  To protect the privacy of neighbouring properties in accordance with Local Plan Policies SC7 and CC2.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the details shown in the approved drawings, prior to first occupation of the hereby permitted development, details of secure cycle storage arrangements designed in accordance with London Plan Policy T5 and Local Plan Policy EC2, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The cycle parking shall conform to the London Cycle Design Standards and hard surface paths not less than 1.2 metres wide shall be provided to the doors of the cycle stores.  The cycle stores shall be made available to occupants upon first occupation of the hereby permitted development and maintained as such thereafter without obstruction.  

Reason:  To ensure that secure cycle parking spaces are provided and retained for the occupiers of the five flats hereby permitted, in accordance with London Plan Policy T5 and Local Plan Policy EC2.

Condition : 8 - Prior to first occupation of the hereby permitted development, full details of the arrangements for the storing of waste and recycled materials (including details of how the placing of waste and recycled materials in a suitable location for collection would be undertaken and managed) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.  

Reason:  To ensure adequate provision for waste and recycling management in accordance with London Plan Policy SI7 and Local Plan Policy CC2.

Condition : 9 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2025 (as amended) (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order), no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/ buildings/enclosures within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out, other than as shown in the approved drawings, and no additional floor space shall be formed within the building(s) hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division (new mezzanine level) without prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Reasons:  To protect neighbours' living conditions and the character and appearance of the area and to prevent over-intensive use of the site in accordance with Local Plan Policies SC7, CC1 and CC2.

Condition : 10 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the Local Planning Authority shall be informed of the agreed naming and numbering of the proposed dwellings so that arrangements can be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of a person eligible for a disabled person's badge issued pursuant to Section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Persons Act 1970 (or similar legislation), no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit.  Any occupiers of the approved development shall surrender any such permit wrongly issued or held.  

Reason:  To prevent additional demand for limited existing public highway car parking capacity to protect the availability of such car parking for existing residents in accordance with Local Plan Policy EC2.

Condition : 11 - Prior to first occupation of the hereby permitted development, all rooftop solar panels previously permitted by Approval of Details Consent P/2024/3169 shall be implemented in full accordance with such details, brought into operational use before first occupation and permanently retained as such.  

Reason:  To ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions in accordance with London Plan Policy SI2 and Local Plan Policy EQ1.

Condition : 12 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) hereby permitted, the development shall have been constructed to achieve an internal water use of 105 litres/person/day or less.  

Reason:  To protect and conserve water supplies and resources in accordance with London Plan Policy SI5.

Condition : 13 - The development shall not be occupied until the existing redundant vehicular access from Waldeck Road is permanently closed with kerbs and footway reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement.  

Reason:  In the interests of pedestrian and vehicle safety in accordance with Local Plan Policy EC2.

Condition : 14 - The developer has previously carried out a joint survey of public highway conditions adjoining the development site with the Local Highways Authority (Hounslow Highways), as confirmed by Approval of Details Consent P/2023/2779.  Loading and unloading of plant and materials used in constructing the development hereby permitted shall not take place from the highway without the prior written permission of the Local Highways Authority.  Storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development shall be entirely within the development site and not extend above the height of any shared boundary treatment.  During works, if any excavation takes place, an appropriate wheel-washing system shall be operated to remove mud, stones and other extraneous materials from vehicle wheels and chassis' leaving the site, and all departing loads shall be fully covered to ensure no material is deposited on the highway.  The exit from the wheel wash shall be a hard, non-porous surface sited as far away from the site exit as is possible given the site constraints and kept clean at all times.  Waste water discharged from the wheel wash shall be stored and disposed of on site and not discharged into the public sewer unless soil, stones and any suspended material have first been removed.  For deliveries and collections, the developer shall use operators committed to best practice as demonstrated by membership of TFL's Freight Operator Recognition Scheme, or similar.  The developer shall ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to adjoining properties, in accordance with the guidance at https://www.london.gov.uk/file/18750/download?token=zV3ZKTpP.  Site lighting shall be designed, positioned and directed so as not to unnecessarily intrude on passing drivers or direct light into any neighbouring windows, in accordance with the guidance provided by the Institute of Lighting Engineers Guidance Note:  The Reduction of Obtrusive Light 2021.
